propositions: The rate-limit sweep's transport file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() and does not detect when a classified mutating method is renamed or moved to an unswept sibling module.

A package-wide glob to derive the file list would require individual mutating/non-mutating classification for 90 members across 8 modules and would silently redefine the sweep's scope from transport layer to entire package, contradicting the original 8a5e design decision.

The anti-drift guard option retains the explicit transport file list and validates that any classified mutating name outside the swept modules must be a pure same-name self.transport delegation, rejecting guards, retries, logging, or argument transforms.

Scanning all 8 unswept Jira adapter modules for names already in _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING yields exactly 2 benign definitions: backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment, both confirmed pure delegations.

The anti-drift implementation uses AST parsing to programmatically verify the pure facade shape and fails the build when new or moved unswept definitions use classified mutating names unless they match the exact facade predicate.
The scope reconciliation includes acli_subprocess.py and jira_fields.py in the anti-drift assertion, both previously missing from hand-written scope notes.
